purpose: Prioritize payload copies measured in the first pilot, without claiming an identified cause yet.

candidate_screen.interpretation: Pilot candidate selection, not independent five-repeat evidence.

single_changes.pinned: Reuse plus pinned host allocation; compare with reuse to isolate allocation type
single_changes.unroll: Only Worker snapshot word loop unrolled eightfold; volatile loads and private validation preserved
single_changes.chunk: Only Guest pack memcpy divided into <=1MiB chunks

formal_selection: Freeze after pilot; repeat supported candidates independently five times, account for selection using separate formal samples.
cpu_topology: Original Guest CPUs0-7 are NUMA0; Worker16-19 NUMA1; GPU1 is NUMA0. Same placement retained in primary comparison; NUMA candidate changes worker affinity separately.
